inputs.phase_description: Introduction to the serious game mechanics and environment

roster.name: Model Monica
roster.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.
roster.priorities: Optimizing, deploying, and monitoring high-performing ML models. Maximizing predictive performance of models. Exploring new algorithms and features.

roster.name: Efficiency Emilia
roster.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.
roster.priorities: Applying deep domain knowledge to ensure models fulfill specific business goals. Aligning ML solutions with clear objectives, KPIs, and business goals. Making organization-level decisions and enhancing overall operational capability. Defining products by defining and optimizing product features.

patterns.name: Undocumented Handover
patterns.description: Models are promoted without documentation or agreed acceptance criteria.

patterns.name: Gated Promotion
patterns.description: A model only reaches the registry after passing agreed acceptance criteria.

patterns.name: Enforced Data Contracts
patterns.description: Producers agree a schema, and every batch is checked against it on arrival.

patterns.name: Documented Promotion
patterns.description: Every promoted model carries a model card and a risk assessment.

patterns.name: Business Aligned Metrics
patterns.description: The KPI the business agreed on is what production monitoring measures.

inputs.angle: something happening out in the world the product serves: weather, a season, a holiday, a sudden run on one article

output.name: The Summer Forecast Gap
output.description: A sudden heatwave has skewed demand for seasonal goods, exposing that our KPI definitions do not account for weather driven spikes. #model_monica# wants to automate the KPI tracking to capture these shifts in real time, while #efficiency_emilia# prefers to keep the process manual to ensure every metric aligns with the broader business strategy. #efficiency_emilia# might accept an automated solution if it clearly supports the agreed business goals.
output.round_introduction: Welcome to the Shelfcast project. You are now the project manager responsible for coordinating our MLOps team. Today, we are addressing a critical gap in how we measure success during volatile weather events.

on_enter_ops.reason: The heatwave invalidated the current static KPI definitions, leaving the team without a clear metric to judge forecast accuracy for seasonal items.

stalemate_ops.reason: Without an agreed KPI framework, the next promotion week will be planned without any objective measure of forecast reliability.
